authorization: Accepted by the user on 4 Nov 2026: all sections (approved_sections), including bot listing durations weighted toward 1 hour. Player listing durations follow the stock picker. Isolated lab only. Items section (v1) per user direction 4 Nov 2026; numbers proposed by Claude and accepted in conversation.

price.card_maximum_note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: non-special bronze/silver can never trade above 10,000 (matches the listing cap).
price.special_percent_note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: only superstar specials (base card rated superstar_base_rating+, i.e. Messi and Ronaldo) take the rating-graded special premium, so only their TOTS/TOTY/RB reach the cap; every other special is priced at its boosted rating with no extra premium.
price.special_maximum_note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: specials other than superstars (Messi/Ronaldo) stay below 5M, in order: above special_soft_cap_from the excess is compressed smoothly toward special_maximum.

pace_curve.note: x full_bonus at the position's great pace (low_tier_pace.great_pace) for 81+. Non-elite golds 75-85 also get a bonus ramping from start_percent at great-within up to full at great (75-80: applied to the gold floor, never lowering the pace premium). Slow cards are never discounted.

sale.note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: at or below 90% of fair a sale is very likely (95%) for every card type; most sales happen early: sale time = duration * u^3 (half of sales in the first 1/8 of the listing).
sale.speed_note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: sale speed follows underpricing; <=70% of fair sells in 2-20 s, 70-100% scales the time down linearly.

supply.duration_note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: most bot listings are 1 hour by far. Drawn once per listing at creation; never rerolled.

low_tier_pace.note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: pace drives below-81 prices relative to what is great for the position, very high with a top league. Golds 75-80 get 60% of the same silver (silver cups keep silvers dearer).

mid_gold.note: User direction 4 Nov 2026: non-elite golds 81-85 above great pace get the steep pace premium; it replaces the flat league and pace bonuses there.

league_bonus.note: Percent multipliers. high: cards 81+. low_tier/combo: pace premium below 81. PL and LaLiga highest, Bundesliga and Serie A a bit less, Ligue 1 least.

bidding.note: Placeholder (Claude): a bot that will outbid answers after this many seconds (seeded per bid), never after expiry.

listing.note: Player listing durations accepted (1397 genuine list used 3600). Placeholder set mirrors bot supply.

items.note: User direction 4 Nov 2026 (follow the stock mobile client): club items and managers trade both ways; training/healing/position/formation consumables are sellable only (no consumables search category). No coach/physio supply.

club_curve.note: Badges and kits: 150 up to card value 74, x1.38 per point, capped at 5,000 (Bayern 85).

stadium.note: Generic stadiums (value < 80) at 150; famous grounds 1,000-5,000 by capacity.

manager.note: Near quick-sell; a bit higher for gold, rare and top-nation managers (no league column in managercards).

position.note: Relatively expensive; into a more attacking role costs more.

supply.note: Bot inventory per stock search category; staff = managers only.
